public class Contact {
    private String name;
    private Contact lastSender;

    public Contact(String name) {
        this.name = name;
        this.lastSender = null;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

    public void rename(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public Contact getLastSender() {
        return lastSender;
    }

    public void sendTo(Contact recipient) {
        recipient.receiveFrom(this);
    }

    public void receiveFrom(Contact sender) {
        this.lastSender = sender;
    }
}
